name: Editorial Pop
derivedFrom: Walmart — The Chicken Purse That Sold Out in 90 Minutes (2026)
summary: Premium hybrid of business documentary and viral retail commercial. Huge Poppins display on saturated retail color, clean white product cards, halftone and grain, hard-cut kinetic editing with mask reveals and yellow highlighter emphasis.

usage.blue: Primary stage, Walmart/retail brand moments, product UI.
usage.yellow: Price, emphasis, highlighter blocks, CTA, key numbers.
usage.orange: Food, heat, energy, viral moments, secondary cards.
usage.purple: Traditional flavor trim, fashion, premium counterpoint.
usage.cream: Editorial pause, paper cards, receipts, comparison stage.
usage.red: Sold out, scarcity, urgency. Use once per film.

typography.fallback: SF Pro Display, SF Pro Text, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
typography.case: UPPERCASE for display and labels, sentence case for captions and body
typography.highlighter: yellow block behind one word or one line, dark ink text, 8-12px radius

components.stage: Full-bleed gradient + two radial glows + halftone dots + film grain + vignette.
components.photo: Ken Burns still, 1.02-1.26 scale, warm/vivid grade, bottom color wash.
components.photoCard: White 4-8px border, 16-22px radius, hard shadow, optional cream label chip.
components.maskLine: Display line rises inside an overflow mask, 0.55-0.75s, easeOut.
components.headline: 2-4 uppercase lines, last line may sit on a yellow highlighter block.
components.tag: Small glass chip, uppercase Poppins 700, 10-14px, 0.16em tracking.
components.priceTag: Oversized yellow hang tag, 3D rotateY entry, blue WALMART chip, punched hole.
components.stamp: Double-outline rubber stamp, rotated -9deg, slams from 2.4x scale.
components.receipt: Cream thermal receipt with torn edge clip-path, barcode, item rows.
components.commentCard: White social card, avatar disc, handle, large sentence, engagement row.
components.phoneUI: Product page card, stock bar, countdown, ADD TO CART, sold-out state.
components.sketch: Blueprint line drawing with animated stroke-dashoffset and callouts.

transitions: hard cut with a 0.1-0.3s yellow or blue flash mask
product card slam from 0.9x to 1x with 26px rise
vertical panel slide for full-screen statements
motion.camera: slow 2-8% push or pull on every still; never a static frame for more than 4s
motion.holds: end every scene on a 0.4-0.8s held frame before the cut

hook.job: Impossible product claim, product slam, record scratch, cluck.

story.job: Real context, social-listening interface, countable proof.

build.job: Idea, packaging spec, sketch, material, product reveal.

price.job: Price tag, grounded comparison, receipt, unit count, accessories.

viral.job: Launch UI, countdown, sold-out stamp, resale consequence.

ending.job: Product hero, customer-joke insight, lesson card, CTA.

sound.music: Energetic funk-pop bed, -19 LUFS before mix, 2.6kHz speech carve, duck 54% under narration.
sound.voice: Deep confident documentary voice; keep SD_VOICE_03 unless the brief names another.
sound.mix: Voice 0.92, music 0.16-0.24 linear, SFX global 0.7, no two impacts within 0.12s.

do: Let the headline be the first thing the eye finds.
Use official product photography and real brand marks for editorial case studies.
Label any reconstructed social feed or illustrative UI.
Keep every number traceable to a named source.
Animate the product, not the frame: cards, tags, stamps and receipts.
dont: No progress bars, scene numbers, top labels or bottom title bars.
No fake statistics, fake executive quotes or invented dialogue.
No generic stock footage repeated across beats.
No more than two accent colors in one frame.
No rainbow gradients or soft corporate blur.
No caption over a bottom-anchored chip; keep scene content above the caption band.

code.usage: import { C, FONT, BRAND, useStage, STAGE } from './config/presets/editorialPop'; import { Stage, Headline, PhotoCard, MaskLine, Tag, PriceTag, Stamp, Receipt, CommentCard } from './components/presets/editorialPop/kit';
